question: Who among the following has been appointed as the Chairman of Indian Space Research Organisation in January 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Dr. V Narayanan**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Dr. V Narayanan** has been appointed as the** Chairman of the Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO)** in January 2025.
 
• He is a distinguished scientist and has made significant contributions to **space propulsion systems** during his tenure at ISRO.
 
• Dr. Narayanan previously served as the **Director of the Liquid Propulsion Systems Centre (LPSC**), which plays a pivotal role in developing propulsion systems for ISRO's space missions.
 
• Under his leadership, ISRO aims to continue advancing its position in global space exploration and satellite technology.
 
• He succeeds the former Chairman, ensuring continuity in ISRO's ambitious projects like **Gaganyaan, Chandrayaan, and interplanetary missions**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **ISRO Overview:**

 
 
• The Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO) is India's national space agency, established in **1969**.
 
• It operates under the Department of Space, Government of India, and is headquartered in Bengaluru.
 
• ISRO is renowned for its cost-effective space missions, including **Mangalyaan (Mars Orbiter Mission)** and **Chandrayaan missions**.
 
 
 
• **Liquid Propulsion Systems Centre (LPSC):**
 
 
• LPSC is one of ISRO's key centers, responsible for developing liquid propulsion systems for launch vehicles and spacecraft.
 
• It plays a critical role in missions such as PSLV, GSLV, and cryogenic engine development.
 
 
 
• **ISRO's Major Missions:**
 
 
• **Gaganyaan:** India's first human spaceflight mission, aiming to send astronauts to space by 2026 and 2027.
 
• **Chandrayaan-3:** A lunar exploration mission focused on soft-landing technology.
 
• **Mangalyaan-2:** The second Mars mission to further study the Martian atmosphere.
 
 
 
• **Future Vision:**
 
 
• ISRO is expanding international collaborations and private-sector involvement in space technology.
 
• It aims to strengthen India's position in satellite launches, interplanetary exploration, and space-based applications for societal benefits.
